label: Filter grid (a control drives a grid)
description: A CONTROL DRIVES A GRID -- the product's filter shown doing its job. A segmented control flips (Show / Blur / Hide) and the matching tiles blur under a pill ('Likely AI', 'Bot'), or leave and the rest reflow into the gaps; a keep-only step sends everything else flying and snaps the survivors into a framed grid ('search by colour', 'only high-intent leads'). Full-frame; the grid sits at x/y, the control panel at control.x/y. Example: {"items":[{"src":"..."},{"src":"...","flag":"Likely AI"}],"cols":3,"control":{"title":"AI content","subtitle":"Content detected as likely generated by AI","options":["Show","Blur","Hide"]},"steps":[{"at":1.2,"option":"Blur"},{"at":2.4,"option":"Hide"}]}.

items.label: Tiles: image URLs, or {src, flag? (the pill text; marks it for 'flagged'), tags? (for keep/hide by tag)}

cell.label: Tile width as a fraction of the frame width (default 0.085)

gap.label: Gap as a fraction of the width (default 0.007)

at.label: When the tiles pop in (s, default 0.2)

control.label: The segmented control panel, or omit for none: {title, subtitle?, options (default Show/Blur/Hide), selected? (index), x, y (0-1, its top-left), width?, size?, at?}

steps.label: In order: {at, option? (flips the control: its label or index), action? (blur | hide | show | keep; default from the option's name), match? ('flagged' default | a tag | 'all'), and for keep: cols, cell, aspect, x, y, frame (default true), frame_color}

frame_color.label: Frame colour around a kept set (default #bc361b)
